name: Protoalligator
isnote: Possibly an orientalosuchin (early Asian alligatoroids), but not all studies agree on that group or its alligatoroid position.
sum: Paleocene alligatoroid from China, first described as a species of Eoalligator and given its own genus in 2016.
holotype: A single partial skull from the Wanghudun Formation, China (Young 1982).
biology: Part of an early radiation of alligatoroids in Asia, if the orientalosuchin placement is correct.
author: Wang et al. 2016

sources.text: Yan-Yin Wang 2016. Taxonomic revision of Eoalligator (Crocodylia, Brevirostres) and the paleogeographic origins of the Chinese alligatoroids. PeerJ 4. doi:10.7717/peerj.2356
